requirement:
Create a small Go module using only the standard library. Use exactly this go.mod:
module example.com/task

go 1.22

Put the implementation in `lib/chunk.go` (package `lib`) and your own tests in `lib/chunk_test.go` (package `lib`, `go test`). No third-party modules.

SPEC: Implement `func Chunk(xs []int, size int) ([][]int, error)`. Split xs into consecutive slices of length size (the last may be shorter). size <= 0 returns a non-nil error. An empty xs returns an empty result.
acceptance_criteria: func Chunk(xs []int, size int) ([][]int, error): Split xs into consecutive slices of length size (the last may be shorter). size <= 0 returns a non-nil error. An empty xs returns an empty result.
